description: This file defines the 'Antispam' class within the Opencart"Catalog\Model\Cms" namespace. It extends a base Model class from Opencart's engine and provides a method to detect spam comments by querying the database for specific keywords.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class for detecting spam comments in the CMS module of the Opencart catalog.

methods.name: getSpam
methods.description: Checks if the given comment contains spam keywords by querying the 'antispam' database table.
